Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (2): r01 and r08, reason summary_outlier. Their largest flank difference sits at 84 µm from the tip, against a batch median of 316 µm (z -5.05). It also has the opposite sign: -0.47 %/h against a median of 0.55 %/h. Their centre REGR peak is about twice the batch median (0.72 vs 0.37 %/h, z 7.87). Their peak position and growth-zone length are like the batch, and all three checks pass.
Cleared (6): r02, r03, r04, r05, r06 and r07. All checks pass, every summary has |z| ≤ 1.42, and no remedies were kept and no roll backs made.
What the flagged runs share: a curvature-rate profile of another shape, with the flank difference near the tip and reversed in sign, plus a high REGR peak. They kept no remedies, made no roll backs and did not use the width-free ratio.
Note: the final measurements repeat exactly across runs. r01 = r08, r02 = r04 = r07 and r03 = r05 = r06, even though their step counts differ. Please confirm these are separate roots or time windows and not copied or re-processed data. If they are copies, the batch medians and z values are biased.
